proceedings.supporting_quote: By a decision dated 15 March 2001, the Banking Regulation and Supervision Board... resolved to transfer the management and control of İktisat Bankası T.A.Ş.
on 14 September 2001, the Fund resolved to recover 726,122,000 Turkish liras from the former shareholders
On 9 May 2006, a debt liquidation protocol ( Borç Tasfiye Protokolü , hereinafter referred to as “the Liquidation Protocol”) was signed

proceedings.deciding_body: 13th Chamber of the Supreme Administrative Court
proceedings.supporting_quote: On 20 July 2006, the Supreme Administrative Court, ruling unanimously, found that the applicant had a legal interest in the enforcement proceedings
On 19 July 2007, the Fund decided to establish two economic and commercial units: one for Viva TV and the other for Radio Viva.

On 1 August 2007, the Industrial Development Bank of Türkiye... issued a report and determined that the value of the Radio Viva Economic and Commercial Unit... was 4,258,000 United States dollars (USD), while the value of the Viva TV Economic and Commercial Unit... was USD 373,400.
On 29 August 2007, the Fund resolved to offer both Viva TV and Radio Viva for sale together in a single tendering process

On 3 April 2008, the Fund concluded that the Erol Aksoy Group had failed to fulfil several commitments and obligations set out in the Liquidation Protocol... Consequently, the Fund decided to rely on its provisions concerning default.
On 18 September 2008, the Fund further resolved to transfer the management and control of all companies within the Erol Aksoy Group to itself
On 30 June 2009, a valuation report issued by TSKB determined that the value of Radio Viva was USD 5,782,000 and the value of Viva TV was USD 132,000.
On 9 July 2009, the Fund decided to merge the two economic and commercial units, thereby creating the Viva TV-Radio Viva Economic and Commercial Unit
On 5 November 2009, the Fund resolved to offer Viva TV-Radio Viva for sale
On 13 January 2011, the Fund decided to offer Viva TV-Radio Viva for sale again
on 3 May 2012, the Fund approved the award of Viva TV-Radio Viva to company A.
On the same day... the Fund transferred the ownership of Viva TV-Radio Viva to company A.
